name: Lanternfish
desc: Small, abundant deep-sea fish that rise toward the surface at night and are the staple food of king penguins and many other predators.
about: Lanternfish (or myctophids, from the Greek μυκτήρ myktḗr, "nose" and ophis, "serpent") are small mesopelagic fish of the large family Myctophidae.
